changes: A new panel now starts with the segment gateway on (segments+playlist): xc_fanout answers HLS segments, keys and known viewers' playlist refreshes instead of PHP-FPM, and hands PHP anything it is not sure of. An updated panel keeps its setting, and a stored value that is not a mode falls back to the default.

The segment gateway now also answers a known MPEG-TS viewer that reconnects with its link, streaming from fanout without a PHP request (needs an xc_fanout release with TS reconnects; older ones keep sending TS to PHP).
A fanout TS viewer no longer costs a database or agent round-trip after the hand-off to the daemon.
Fixed the prebuffer of a restreamer link that asks for one on fanout: it was always 0, it is now one segment's time.
Added an Always Use ffmpeg switch per stream (Advanced tab and bulk edit): it keeps a copy-only channel on ffmpeg when the native remuxer is the source backend.

The native remuxer now reads a stream's source URL, headers, cookies and proxy from a private file instead of its command line, where any local user could read the provider's credentials (needs xc_fanout 0.14.8 or later; the stream's log says when it falls back).
Every admin page now shows a toast when a stream starts, stops, restarts or fails, on any server; a burst of events shows as one counted toast.
Fixed stream starts on a load balancer installed straight into API mode: no stream could start there.
Fixed the VOD file browser opening on an empty folder: it now leads from / to the scan roots.
The Watch module can tell a file still being copied on a load balancer from a finished one, and a load balancer's folder of thousands of files is listed whole.
